items.title: Pizza Hut’s sale to LongRange Capital is complete
items.summary: Yum Brands sold the legacy pizza chain to the private equity firm and Yum China in two separate deals for a total of $2.7 billion.

items.title: Yum! Brands Completes Sale of Pizza Hut to LongRange Capital
items.summary: Yum! Brands announced the completion of the sale of Pizza Hut, excluding Mainland China (“Pizza Hut Ex-China”), to LongRange Capital (“LongRange”) for approximately $1.5 billion, subject to certain adjustments, with the opportunity for Yum! to receive an additional earn-out of $75 million by 2030 based on future performance.
